0022600143.text: The Clippers (1-2, 3rd in the Pacific and 8th in the West) host the Lakers (3-0, 1st in the Pacific and 3rd in the West), with the Clippers on a two-game losing streak and the Lakers riding three straight wins. Los Angeles Clippers players out are Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis in the foot), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while the Lakers are without Adou Thiero (knee inflammation). The Clippers trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 125-117 loss in Los Angeles on October 23, and the two teams split 2-2 in 2025-26.
